items.title: Bulk upload with a validation report
items.detail: src/upload.js holds the validator, the multipart parser and the collection contracts; GET and POST /api/v1/upload (src/routes/upload.js:53) serve the contract and accept multipart, text/csv and JSON through one validator with dry_run, a 20-error-capped row-level report and a refusal of partial import (src/routes/upload.js:53). Two spec items were deliberately not built and are documented as deviations in the ENH entry: it buffers under DEFAULT_MAX_BODY_BYTES instead of streaming to disk, and there is no client-side CSV picker (the only file input in public/ is a camera capture on the CHW surface, public/chw/index.html:545).

items.title: Two-way SMS acknowledgement, escalation, and delivery tracking
items.detail: Shipped as `src/rapidpro.js`. An anchored verb grammar (`REPLY_VERBS` at `src/rapidpro.js:655` — ACK/ESCALATE/RESOLVED/NAK/DONE) over a **closed** set of reason codes; an unrecognised code is kept as `reason_raw` with `reason_code` null rather than invented. Correlation prefers an explicit id and otherwise matches the sender inside a bounded window — a reply that can close an SLA is attacker-controlled input, so it is never correlated by a payload-supplied `alert_event_id`, and the route sits behind the same webhook verification as a field report. `reconcileInbound` dedupes ALERT-06 against the same id shape the field-report route uses. Escalation fires only for dispatches the **gateway accepted**, so our own outage cannot escalate; the clock runs from the first page for an alert; any reply counts as a response; a recipient already escalated is not escalated again, and the boundary is asserted exactly. Delivery stops at `accepted_by_gateway` (`src/rapidpro.js:975`) because RapidPro v2 gives no per-recipient receipt — 'delivered' would be a claim the system cannot support. Uncorrelated replies are recorded and answered 202, because a wrong sender number is information. Served at `/api/v1/rapidpro/reply`, `/delivery` and `/escalations` (`src/routes/rapidpro.js:80-82`). Guarded by `test/rapidpro-two-way.test.js`.

items.title: Export that carries the narrative
items.detail: Shipped as `renderExportMarkdown` (`src/reports.js:1027`), which composes with `renderReportMarkdown` rather than reimplementing it, so the export and the `GET /api/v1/reports/:id/export.md` route cannot disagree. Refusal vocabulary is imported from `MODEL_BASIS` rather than retyped. A withheld figure prints as 'not measured', never a dash in a column of numbers. `scripts/check-no-flood-probability.mjs` gained the rule the term list cannot catch — a null rendered, or a refusal named without its reason beside it — and fails the build on it. Served at `GET /api/v1/kpi/quarterly.md` (`src/routes/kpi.js:47`); the PDF carries the same narrative page. Guarded by `scripts/check-no-flood-probability.mjs`.

items.title: A donor-inspectable, hash-chained audit trail
items.detail: Shipped as `src/audit-chain.js`. `verifyChain` carries the **recomputed** hash forward as the next entry's expected predecessor and compares the stored field to that, so a consistently re-chained file is caught; the anchor is a head published out of band, and without one the result carries an `unanchored` advisory rather than passing. The preimage is a field whitelist including `created_at`, which `canonicalHash` drops. Covers the log, not the records (ADR-007). Served at `GET /api/v1/audit/verify` and `/audit/head` (`src/routes/provenance.js:57`). Guarded by `test/audit-chain.test.js`, `test/parametric-trigger.test.js`.

items.title: A store conformance suite, a real schema, and migrations
items.detail: Shipped. `src/store.js`'s `SCHEMA` is one frozen declaration of `{key, kind, derived, quarantines}`; `COLLECTIONS` is derived from it and a test asserts that. `assertDeclaredCollections` runs at the top of `write`/`merge`/`replaceAnalytics` on **both** adapters before any serialisation, so a refused write leaves the store usable. 69 entries — 59 records and 10 quarantines, the latter generated from `QUARANTINE_SOURCES` — are declared in one place, and `COLLECTIONS` is derived from it. Migrations are versioned, ordered and idempotent with a recorded applied-version, exercised against **real Postgres 18.2** via `test/pg-harness.mjs`, which provisions a cluster and fails under CI rather than skipping — that found three shipped bugs, because every Postgres test used to skip. The Postgres half of the conformance suite is now reached in CI: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:67` and `:109` set `LINDELA_LITE_TEST_DATABASE_URL`, which the ledger's original note said no job did. Still partial: the single `lite_records` JSONB table remains, with per-collection columns added only as generated expressions over the body rather than as typed columns, and the two stores can still diverge, since `JsonStore.remove()` and the Postgres equivalents are asserted separately rather than by one shared driver. Guarded by `test/store-conformance.test.js`, `test/migrations.test.js`.

Migrations are versioned, ordered and idempotent with a recorded applied-version. Exercised against REAL Postgres 18.2 via test/pg-harness.mjs, which provisions a cluster and fails under CI rather than skipping — that found three shipped bugs, because every Postgres test used to skip.

items.title: API substrate: pagination, conditional requests, idempotency, readiness
items.detail: All five parts are in place and exercised by 39 passing tests (test/api-substrate.test.js). Cursor pagination with a total-count envelope is collectionPage (src/utils.js:369) at 29 call sites across src/routes/; ETag and 304 handling is in jsonResponse (src/utils.js:742-765); the Idempotency-Key wrapper is handleApi (src/server.js:846-952), scoped by subject+method+path and replaying only sub-400 responses; GET /api/v1/ready probes the store with a timeout and reports mode, reachability and latency (src/routes/liveness.js:164-337); and the OpenAPI document is diffed against the route table read off every module under src/routes/ plus src/server.js by scripts/route-surface.mjs (scripts/check-openapi.mjs:34), run inside npm run validate (scripts/validate.mjs:264), which CI executes. One endpoint opts out of the envelope — GET /api/v1/kpi/snapshots returns a raw unpaginated list (src/routes/kpi.js:101).
